method: Extruded line-width footprints; 0.05 mm inter-layer connectivity tolerance. Both bridge endpoints checked against previous-layer and same-layer paths deposited before that bridge. This is a toolpath check, not a physical bridging or retention test.
socket_probe_method: Three by three socket-core grid, ten depths per lane; 0.45 mm edge margin. Extrusion footprint at the layer containing each 3D probe must clear it by 0.10 mm.
